name: partnerize-mcp
description: Partnerize (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report. Every tool maps to a documented end

platform_mcp_partnerize_application_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PARTNERIZE_APPLICATION_KEY
platform_mcp_partnerize_application_key.description: Partnerize application_key (identifies the Network; Partnerize console > Settings > API credentials), the HTTP Basic username.

platform_mcp_partnerize_user_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PARTNERIZE_USER_API_KEY
platform_mcp_partnerize_user_api_key.description: The user's user_api_key, the HTTP Basic password; results are limited to the user's brand permissions.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v3/brand: the brands the user can access ({data: [{brand_id, brand_name}]}); there is no user profile endpoint.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /v3/brand: brands (advertisers) the user has access to. `id` is the brand id that list_campaigns takes as account_id; the brand currency is on GET /user/advertiser/{id} (default_currency).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /user/advertiser/{brand_id}/campaign: the brand's campaigns (programmes). status is a single letter: a = active, p = pending, r = rejected, n = inactive. Partnerize campaigns are commission-based (default_commission_rate / is_cpc in raw) and carry no budget; `status`, `page` and `limit` are not sent.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /reporting/report_advertiser/campaign/{campaign_id}/conversion.json?start_date&end_date (whole UTC days): one row per conversion (not aggregated) for one campaign; campaign_id is REQUIRED. `spend` is the conversion's commission (what the brand pays, including the network fee) and publisher_commission the partner's share; up to 300 rows per call (count holds the total; offset paging is not followed). Totals per currency are in the response's total_* fields. `account_id` is not sent.
